messages:
mike: quick follow-up from the postmortem — we saw repeated KVCache stalls causing p95 tail on generation to spike. need firm owners/dates for SLO edits, dashboards, recurrence detection, and a short-term mitigation plan.

tara: i'll draft the SLO change request and include measurement queries. thinking of a scoped "large-context" SLO: p95=250ms for requests with ctx>2048 or >5 turns. ETA: 48h.

sasha: i'll own dashboards & alerts. plan: add per-route/model p50/p95/p99, rolling burn-rate, and a recurrence detector that counts identical root_cause tags. i'll make the alert fire if same root_cause appears >=3 times in 45d. ETA: 36h.

ben: runtime fixes here — i'll prototype an adaptive throttle (inflight queue + kv_hit_ratio) and a conservative batching rollback switch. goal: staging repro today, draft PR in 5 business days.

mike: owners summary: tara (SLO ticket + governance) - 48h, sasha (dash+alerts + recurrence rule) - 36h, ben (throttle + batching plan) - PR in 5bd. I'll update the postmortem with these owners and dates.

tara: SLO ticket draft will include queries such as: `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, route, model))` and a split for `ctx_size>2048`. I'll tag product & reliability for sign-off.

sasha: dash ticket created D-4510. adding a "recent postmortems" list and a widget showing per-model p95 delta vs baseline. recurrence detector will be a small counter UX that links back to postmortem docs.

ben: throttle heuristic proto: `if kv_hit_ratio < 0.6 && inflight_queue > 180 then preferentially defer long-context requests else allow`. Will expose a soft-stepping backoff rather than hard drop. PR-6119 (draft) with staging repro & trace links: http://go/trace/INC-2026-442.

mike: decision on error budgets: i recommend we DO NOT reset. the burn is a real signal and should stay visible to prioritize fixes. unless governance forces a reset, keep it.

tara: agree — no reset. i'll note an exception window in the ticket for measurement clarity while we roll mitigations. also asking governance for an expedited review.

sasha: added alert rule test and a simulated recurrence run — it increments the counter and fires a test alert. will promote to prod after SLO sign-off. also added a "jump to traces" link and runbook snippet.

ben: note on batching: we'll run a canary (1% -> 10%) when batching defaults change. if the throttle + dash show improvement, we'll promote. mike, can you coordinate canary timing with infra?

mike: yes i'll coordinate canary window and post timeline here. scheduling a sync for 2026-04-03 14:00 UTC to review progress. @remind-bot set reminder.

remind-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-03 14:00 UTC.

tara: SLO ticket SLO-2026-780 opened with measurement queries, scoped-SLO text, and product tag. requested sign-off within 48h.

sasha: dashboard pushed to staging; recurrence detector added and tested. will promote on sign-off.

ben: PR-6119 posted as draft. will iterate after staging runs. please review when you have a chance.

mike: final recap: tara (SLO ticket) - 48h, sasha (dash+recurrence detector) - 36h, ben (throttle + PR) - 5bd, mike (canary coordination & postmortem update) - schedule posted. no error budget reset. 2-week follow-up scheduled for recurrence validation. closing thread, update tickets as progress is made. thanks all :thumbsup:
